name: Low-Carb Chicken Saag (Palak Chicken)
ingredients_verbatim: 10 oz frozen chopped spinach, defrosted and drained
why: Verified published nutrition 454 cal / 10g carb / 55g protein per serving - squarely mid-band (400-650 cal, <=35g carb) and high protein. Structurally low-carb: chicken breast simmered in a spinach-yogurt gravy, no rice/potato/pasta base. A genuine braise/stew (chicken slow-simmered in the saag), not a saute. No chicken saag exists in the catalog (no dup vs the tikka/korma/vindaloo/madras curries already live). Every ingredient maps to an existing board commodity (chicken-breast, spinach, yogurt, onions, tomato-paste, garlic, garam-masala, fresh-ginger, ground-turmeric, olive-oil), so it scales cleanly to 14 servings by weight.
